addFunds(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: Adds funds from the owner's wallet to the current range (plain approvals or native BNB for WBNB).

addFundsWithPermit(((address,uint256)[],.notice: Same as {addFunds}, with one Permit2 signature for both tokens (spender: this vault).

claim().notice: Sends the fees ready to claim (per token, plus CAKE) to the owner. Fees still in the pool are         collected first.

claimAsBNB((address,address,uint256,addr.notice: Claims everything as BNB: the other tokens are swapped to WBNB (steps planned off-chain, checked         against a fair price and the owner's tolerance), then unwrapped. What isn't swapped is sent as is.

close(uint256,uint256).notice: Closes the position and sends everything — principal, idle tokens, fees and CAKE — to the owner.         Always works, also while paused.

compound((address,address,uint256,addres.notice: Puts all fees (new and ready to claim) back into the position right away.

openPosition(int24,int24,uint256,uint256.notice: Opens the position with the tokens the factory just moved in. What doesn't fit goes back to the owner.

positionAmounts().notice: Principal in the position right now (excludes idle tokens and fees).

rebalance(int24,int24,(address,address,u.notice: Moves the range around the price once the price has left it. The new range must contain the         current price and obey the position's strategy; the price must agree with the oracle; and enough         time must have passed since the last move.

reinvest((address,address,uint256,addres.notice: Collects fees and adds the reinvested share back into the range once it is worth at least         `minReinvestBps` of the position (the keeper applies stricter thresholds for small positions).

withdraw(uint128,uint256,uint256).notice: Takes part of the liquidity out to the owner's wallet. Earned fees are collected first (and stay         claimable), so only principal is sent. Works while paused.
